item.title: Customs-Clark seizes P119-M shabu concealed in countertops
item.description: (Photo courtesy of BOC) MANILA–Authorities led by the Bureau of Customs-Port of Clark intercepted a shipment containing approximately 17,500 grams of shabu with an estimated street value of PHP119 million, according to a news release Saturday.The shipment originated from Las Vegas, Nevada, USA and was bound for Makati City. It was flagged based on derogatory information provided by Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency.Upon arrival, the parcel underwent X-ray scanning which revealed unusual images.
